The nick vegetous derive from one of the DBZ main caracters, vegeta. It has nothing to do with a salad's ingredient.

== Clan history ==

Vegetous only clan is the famous VQC (Valhala Quake Clan) and he is the second in command high now (not mentioning the fact that VQC use to have only two active members).
